Mildmay.reason: Mildmay Line: No service between Richmond and South Acton while we fix a track fault at Richmond. GOOD SERVICE on the rest of the line.

Tram.reason: LONDON TRAMS: From Thursday 6 until Sunday 30 August, no service between Arena and Elmers End at certain times. On Mondays to Fridays, no service before 0700 and after 1930, on Saturdays, no service before 0800 and after 1845, and on Sundays, no service for the whole day.

Weaver.reason: WEAVER LINE: Monday 17, Tuesday 18, Wednesday 19 and Thursday 20 August, after 2245, no service between Hackney Downs and Chingford. Last trains are at 2231 from Liverpool Street to Chingford and at 2253 from Chingford to Liverpool Street. Replacement bus service L3 operates between Hackney Downs and Chingford via Clapton, St James Street, Walthamstow Central, Wood Street and Highams Park. The last three northbound buses start from Liverpool Street at 0014 0044 and 0114 and also serve Bethnal Green, Cambridge Heath and London Fields (Mare Street).
